Sofia G: Hey @people-ops — noticed my medical premium on today's paystub was split across CA and WA (CA $120 / WA $45). I only have one benefits enrollment in CA. Did a recent address update trigger this?
Anna (People Ops): Thanks for flagging — can you DM a screenshot of the paystub and confirm last 4 of SSN? Also which address is marked as current in ADP?
Sofia G: DMed the screenshot and SSN (xxxx). Current address on ADP is CA (San Jose). I travel to WA for ~3 months a year but still CA resident.
Mike - Payroll: Thanks — I can take a look. @Anna can you check benefits feed for any WA jurisdiction records? Sometimes a temp address creates a duplicate deduction mapping.
Anna (People Ops): Confirmed: benefits enrollment shows CA only. No WA plan enrolled. Will forward the feed extract to payroll ops.
Mike - Payroll: Found the issue — payroll's address normalization picked up a temporary WA mailing address flagged as active, which created a second deduction line mapped to 'WA medical plan' (no employee election). I can do an off-cycle reversal for the WA deduction and reprocess net pay. Off-cycle will show as an adjustment on the next statement or as a separate off-cycle check.
Sofia G: Please do the reversal. Also worried about state reporting — will this cause WA to appear on my W-2 or require any corrections?
Mike - Payroll: Good question — WA has no state income tax, but if there was any state-level withholding/reporting caused by the incorrect deduction we may need to coordinate with the tax team. Likely outcome: off-cycle reverses pay; no taxable wages change for federal/CA. If state reporting was triggered incorrectly, we may need to issue an amended W-2 (W-2c) or file a correction — we'll confirm after audit.
PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2119 created by Mike - Payroll: "WA duplicate medical premium reversal". ETA 3 business days for reversal + audit.
Anna (People Ops): Thanks @Sofia G for the quick follow-up. We'll confirm when reversal posts and update you if any filings are required. If you get any notices from state agencies, ping us immediately. :white_check_mark:
